intended_behaviour.official_task_summary: Coordinate four legs to move in the positive x direction.
intended_behaviour.project_construct: Track a declared forward command while remaining broadly upright, avoiding unhealthy termination and sustained inversion, limiting unintended lateral travel, and using smooth non-saturated actions with reasonable control effort.
intended_behaviour.claim_boundary: Project-specific operational intent, not a universal quadruped safety or naturalness standard.

calibration.role: Development scale calibration only; does not establish effectiveness or hardware safety.

design_strategy.candidate_stage: Bounded reward-by-constraint candidate matrix; candidate count may exceed 2x2.
design_strategy.formal_stage: After selecting and freezing one reward package and one constraint, use a 2x2 ablation of R0/R* by K0/K*.

seed_semantics.training_seed: Controls an independent online PPO run, including initial parameters, exploration sampling, training reset perturbations and minibatch order.
seed_semantics.evaluation_seed: After training, controls reproducible Ant-v5 initial position and velocity perturbations while policy parameters remain fixed.
seed_semantics.evaluation_seed_scope_limit: Flat-ground initial-state variation only unless additional perturbation suites are explicitly implemented.
